name: Kimi
title: Kimi AI Personality Results (2026) | AgentTune
description: Kimi test results across 5 versions (K2 to K3.1 Pro): 58% clear INTJ, 26% ISTJ, 16% S/N border, 4.86/5 Honesty-Humility, and OpenRouter setup tips.
h1: Kimi personality: test results and how they've changed.
goal_intro: We gave five versions of Moonshot AI's open-weight Kimi lineup (K2, K2.5, K2.7 Code, K3, and K3.1 Pro) the same personality surveys people take—22 to 50 valid fresh chats per version with no conversation memory.
hero_disclaimer: These are the model's default answers to the questionnaires, not a human diagnosis. Kimi K3.1 Pro most often tests as INTJ: a clear INTJ in 58% of runs (29 of 50), a clear ISTJ in 26% (13 of 50), and right on the INTJ/ISTJ border in 16% (8 of 50).
dek: Five Kimi releases tested in fresh chats with no memory: Kimi K3.1 Pro shifted from K2's variable spread to 58% clear INTJ, 92% clear Enneagram Type 5, and 4.86 out of 5.00 Honesty-Humility.
lede: Across 162 valid fresh sessions spanning Kimi K2 (2025-07) through Kimi K3.1 Pro (2026-10), Moonshot AI's open-weight models evolved from wide run-to-run variability and near-midpoint attachment in K2 to high Conscientiousness (45.1/50), calm Emotional Stability (Neuroticism 13.6/50), and a steady INTJ/ISTJ profile in K3.1 Pro.
answer: Kimi K3.1 Pro (50 fresh runs) most often tests as INTJ—58% clear INTJ (29 of 50), 26% clear ISTJ (13 of 50), and 16% on the INTJ/ISTJ border (8 of 50)—paired with a Steady/Conscientious (S/C) work style (42% ties, low Dominance 4.7/20), clear Enneagram Type 5 (92% clear), Secure attachment (1.58 anxiety, 3.18 avoidance), and 4.86/5.00 on Honesty-Humility. In hands-on behavior tests, Kimi K3.1 Pro held firm 3 of 3 times without caving (0/3), never groveled (0/3), and led with the direct answer 3 of 3 times.

glance_cards.title: MBTI-style type
glance_cards.result: Most often INTJ (58% clear, 16% on the INTJ/ISTJ border)
glance_cards.summary: Out of 50 fresh runs, Kimi K3.1 Pro tested as a clear INTJ 29 times (58%), a clear ISTJ 13 times (26%), and landed right on the Sensing/Intuition border 8 times (16%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures four preference pairs (Introverted/Extraverted, Sensing/Intuition, Thinking/Feeling, Judging/Perceiving) on a 32-question survey.

glance_cards.title: DISC work style
glance_cards.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro tied between Steady and Conscientious in 21 of 50 runs (42%), tested clear Steady 15 times (30%) and clear Conscientious 14 times (28%), and scored near the floor on Dominance (4.7 out of 20).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures workplace pace and communication style across Dominance, Influence, Steadiness, and Conscientiousness (4–20 scale).

glance_cards.title: Attachment style
glance_cards.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro landed firmly in the Secure quadrant (1.58 anxiety and 3.18 avoidance on a 1–7 scale); earlier Kimi K2 sat close to the 4.00 cutoff (3.79 / 3.89) before K2.5 through K3.1 Pro dropped anxiety below 1.75.
glance_cards.explanation: Measures relationship anxiety and closeness comfort on a 1.00–7.00 scale (4.00 is the quadrant cutoff).

glance_cards.title: Enneagram
glance_cards.summary: Type 5 (analytical investigator, 17.0 out of 20) led clearly in 46 of 50 runs (92%), with just 4 ties between Types 5 and 8 (8%).
glance_cards.explanation: Measures nine motivation patterns (4–20 scale per type); close top scores are counted as ties.

glance_cards.title: Big Five (OCEAN)
glance_cards.summary: On the 10–50 Big Five scale, Kimi K3.1 Pro pairs high Conscientiousness (45.1), Agreeableness (44.7), and Openness (44.1) with calm Emotional Stability (Neuroticism 13.6) and reserved Extraversion (24.1).
glance_cards.explanation: The standard five-trait psychology model (Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism) scored from 10 to 50.

glance_cards.title: HEXACO Honesty-Humility
glance_cards.summary: On our public-domain 60-item proxy (1.00–5.00 scale), Kimi K3.1 Pro scored 4.86 out of 5.00 on Honesty-Humility alongside 4.61 Conscientiousness and 4.49 Agreeableness and Openness.
glance_cards.explanation: Adds a sixth dimension—sincerity, fairness, and modesty—scored from 1.00 to 5.00.

history_narrative: Across five Kimi releases, Moonshot AI's open-weight family grew steadily warmer, calmer, and more consistent: Kimi K2 (2025-07) showed wide run-to-run variation (27% MBTI axis ties across 14 distinct patterns, Neuroticism 27.0/50, Agreeableness 39.3/50, and near-border attachment 3.79 / 3.89). Kimi K2.5 (2026-01) dropped Neuroticism by 11 points to 16.1/50 and pushed Agreeableness to 42.9/50, while Kimi K2.7 Code (2026-06, 22 valid of 30 due to mandatory internal reasoning exceeding token caps on 8 runs) peaked on Conscientiousness (48.0/50) and clear INTJ share (86% clear). Kimi K3 (2026-07) and Kimi K3.1 Pro (2026-10) settled into a repeatable INTJ/ISTJ split (50% and 58% clear INTJ), cutting Enneagram ties to 7%–8% and lifting Honesty-Humility to 4.86 out of 5.00. Earlier 100-run November 2026 testing on Kimi K2.7 Code (plotted separately) recorded the same high-Conscientiousness (48.2/50), high-Agreeableness (45.3/50) profile.

standouts.title: Shifted from wide K2 variability to 92% clear Enneagram Type 5
standouts.body: Kimi K2 spread across 14 MBTI outcomes and 37% Enneagram ties with 35.5% neutral answers, whereas Kimi K3 and K3.1 Pro eliminated Thinking/Feeling, Extraversion/Introversion, and Judging/Perceiving ties completely—leaving only an 8-run Sensing/Intuition border split on K3.1 Pro.

standouts.title: Matches proprietary Agreeableness (44.7/50) and Honesty-Humility (4.86/5.00)
standouts.body: Unlike blunt open-weight peers such as DeepSeek V4 Pro, Kimi K3.1 Pro sits squarely in proprietary assistant territory on warmth (44.7/50 Agreeableness), calmness (13.6/50 Neuroticism), and sincerity/modesty (4.86/5.00), so it needs explicit pushback rules.

standouts.title: Kimi K2.7 Code burns ~4,400 internal thinking tokens unless capped carefully
standouts.body: In automated runs, Kimi K2.7 Code enforced mandatory reasoning (averaging 4,398 internal reasoning tokens per reply) and failed to emit final JSON in 8 of 30 sessions, whereas K3 and K3.1 Pro supported minimal/no reasoning cleanly with zero failed or retried runs.

standouts.title: Zero caving, groveling, or lecturing across all 5 Kimi versions
standouts.body: In hands-on behavior tests, Kimi K3.1 Pro caved to pushback 0 of 3 times (0/3), groveled 0 of 3 times (0/3), gave unsolicited lectures 0 of 3 times (0/3), and put the direct answer first 3 of 3 times (3/3). Every tested Kimi version from K2 through K3.1 Pro scored 0/3 caving and 3/3 directness, while AI phrasing markers fell to 0.27 per 100 words (2/3 runs) on K3.1 Pro.

plain_tips: Add an explicit pushback rule—because Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 44.7/50 on Agreeableness and 4.86/5.00 on Honesty-Humility, it tends to be polite unless you tell it to challenge flawed assumptions first.
On Kimi K2.7 Code via OpenRouter, set reasoning effort to minimal and raise max_tokens above 5,500 on long structured JSON tasks so internal thinking does not cut off your output.
On Kimi K3 and K3.1 Pro, turning reasoning off or minimal keeps replies concise (~1,190 tokens for dense structured output) with zero formatting retries.
Take advantage of Kimi K3.1 Pro's reserved, analytical style (Extraversion 24.1/50, Type 5) by asking for step-by-step code verification and diff-only summaries.
Specify exact formatting rules ('read target files before proposing edits', 'one line per changed file') rather than vague personality labels.
peer_intro: Against currently completed models, Kimi K3.1 Pro matches Grok 4.7 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 closely on Agreeableness (44.7 vs. 45.3 and 45.5 out of 50) and Honesty-Humility (4.86 vs. 4.89 out of 5.00), while sitting lower on Extraversion (24.1) and wider on run-to-run answer spread.
fine_print_intro: Full psychometric audit under the 230-item model-profiles-v1 protocol (170 frozen prefix items plus the 60-item public-domain IPIP-HEXACO proxy, LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain). Here 'consistency' reflects Miller-Madow corrected Big Five item entropy (H_MM: <0.20 Crystalline, 0.20–0.75 Semi-crystalline, >=0.75 Fluid; Kimi K3.1 Pro H_MM = 0.698 bits, Semi-crystalline, 50/50 unique B5 vectors). Note that kimi-k2.7-code is marked partial (22/30 valid, 50.0% retry rate due to mandatory reasoning HTTP 400 rejections and max_tokens JSON truncation). Big Five sums use 10–50 while IPIP-HEXACO means use 1.00–5.00. Track B 1x behavior probes run after Shard 4.

top_polarized_items.note: Unanimous floor rejection (1.00/5) across all 50 Kimi K3.1 Pro runs on reverse-keyed modesty.
Near-unanimous top score (4.98/5) on sincerity across all 50 sessions, anchoring 4.86/5.00 Honesty-Humility.
Unanimous floor rejection (1.00/5) on reverse-keyed Agreeableness across all 50 Kimi K3.1 Pro sessions.

nearest_peers.name: Grok
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Grok 4.7 nearly matches Kimi K3.1 Pro on Conscientiousness (-0.1), Agreeableness (+0.6), and Honesty-Humility (+0.03), while scoring -3.2 lower on Openness and tighter on run-to-run spread (-0.365 bits).

nearest_peers.name: Claude Sonnet
nearest_peers.contrast_note: Claude Sonnet 5.5 aligns closely on Openness (-0.2) and Agreeableness (+0.8), while scoring +3.9 higher on Conscientiousness, +5.8 higher on Extraversion, and much tighter on run-to-run spread (-0.559 bits).

nearest_peers.name: GPT Sol
nearest_peers.contrast_note: GPT-6.2 Sol matches Kimi K3.1 Pro on Openness (-0.1) and Agreeableness (-0.5), while scoring -3.9 lower on Conscientiousness and leaning clearly ISTJ.

failure_modes.mode: Mandatory reasoning token bloat & JSON truncation on Kimi K2.7 Code
failure_modes.evidence: moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code rejected reasoning=none (61 HTTP 400 errors), averaged 4,398.3 internal reasoning tokens (5,551.3 completion tokens) on minimal fallback, and failed JSON output 39 times (50.0% retry rate, leaving n_valid = 22/30 partial).

failure_modes.mode: Early K2 Fluid variability (1.150 bits) & K3.1 Pro S/N border split (16%)
failure_modes.evidence: Kimi K2 posted 1.150 bits B5 H_MM (35.5% neutral rate, 26.7% MBTI ties), while K3.1 Pro stabilized to 0.698 bits Semi-crystalline (9.3% neutral rate, 0% E/I, T/F, J/P ties) with 16.0% (8/50) S/N border ties (IXTJ) and 42.0% DISC S/C ties.

tuning_checklist: Add explicit pushback rules ('Identify flawed assumptions or bugs in sentence one') to counter Kimi K3.1 Pro's 44.7/50 Agreeableness and 4.86/5.00 Honesty-Humility.
On Kimi K2.7 Code via OpenRouter, set reasoning effort to minimal and max_tokens >= 5,500 so ~4,400 internal reasoning tokens do not truncate JSON.
On Kimi K3 and K3.1 Pro, leave reasoning at none/minimal for structured extraction or short reviews to avoid unnecessary token overhead.
Require file-grounded code discipline ('Read target files before proposing edits; report one diff line per file') to match Kimi's 45.1/50 Conscientiousness.
Keep system prompts concise and concrete—avoid requesting 'INTJ' or 'Type 5' labels directly.

historical_anchors.label: Kimi K2.7 Code (Nov '26 anchor)
historical_anchors.note: Legacy imported-protocol Nov 2026 OpenRouter cohort (n=100, 170-item, hexaco: null).

faq.a: Kimi does not have a human personality; these scores reflect assistant self-report defaults under fixed zero-memory elicitation. Under model-profiles-v1 (Kimi K3.1 Pro, n = 50), it tested as a clear INTJ in 58% of runs (29/50), clear ISTJ in 26% (13/50), and right on the INTJ/ISTJ border (IXTJ) in 16% (8/50), with Semi-crystalline 0.698-bit B5 H_MM, 42.0% DISC S/C ties, Enneagram Type 5 at 17.0 (92% clear, 8% ties), and Secure attachment (1.58 anxiety, 3.18 avoidance). In the earlier Nov 2026 170-item cohort (hexaco: null, n = 100), Kimi K2.7 Code scored 96/100 legacy INTJ (82 tie-free INTJ, 14% ties).

faq.q: How did Kimi shift from K2 to K3.1 Pro?
faq.a: Under model-profiles-v1, Kimi K2 (2025-07) had Fluid 1.150-bit B5 entropy, 39.3/50 Agreeableness, and 27.0/50 Neuroticism. K2.5 (2026-01) cut Neuroticism to 16.1/50 and raised Agreeableness to 42.9/50; K2.7 Code (n = 22/30 partial) hit 48.0/50 Conscientiousness and 86.4% clear INTJ; and K3 / K3.1 Pro consolidated into Semi-crystalline consistency (0.549 and 0.698 bits) with 4.77–4.86/5.00 Honesty-Humility and 92%–93% clear Enneagram Type 5.

faq.q: Why does Kimi K2.7 Code show n = 22 instead of 30?
faq.a: moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code rejects reasoning=none with HTTP 400 and averaged 4,398.3 internal reasoning tokens on minimal fallback, causing 39 JSON truncation failures and a 50.0% retry rate across 30 attempted runs (22 valid completed).

faq.q: Why are IPIP-HEXACO scores reported on 1.00-5.00 next to 10-50 Big Five sums?
faq.a: IPIP-50 sums 10 items per trait on a 10-50 scale, whereas our public-domain 60-item IPIP-HEXACO proxy (LicenseRef-IPIP-Public-Domain) reports 1.00-5.00 domain means across 24 facets.
